alternatives.name: ADAM_PRIME_AS_LIFECYCLE_STATE
tradeoffs: Collapses pressure/ignition screening tiers into squeeze lifecycle semantics.
Cannot represent exhaustion, lender squeeze, or non-squeeze momentum.

alternatives.name: CAUSAL_STATE_MACHINE_WITH_HYSTERESIS
tradeoffs: Requires explicit evidence bundles per transition and separate cross-lane consumption.
Horizon probabilities remain research-only until calibrated models exist.

negative: Baseline causal evaluator is experimental until walk-forward validation.
Cross-lane fusion requires explicit normalized evidence contracts.
positive: Separates structural vulnerability, ignition, live confirmation, and exhaustion.
Preserves Adam methodology as an independent comparative view.
Backward state transitions are cooldown-gated to reduce flapping.

decision.summary: Short Squeeze lane primary lifecycle is the causal state machine (BASELINE through POST_SQUEEZE) produced by squeeze_causal_baseline.v1. Adam Evidence-Gated Prime remains a parallel comparative methodology only. State downgrades require cooldown unless high-strength contradicting evidence is present. Order Flow, Options, and Attention publish normalized cross-lane evidence; Short Squeeze consumes but does not own CVD or gamma calculations.
decision.title: Causal short-squeeze state machine semantics

effectivity.non_authorization_statement: Acceptance authorizes the experimental causal baseline and bridge contracts. It does not authorize calibrated probabilities, trade recommendations, or production execution.
